reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is locally aggregating and visualizing token usage through a persistent sidebar and Token Usage settings page.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中本地记录并可视化今日、昨日、累计及按提供商和模型划分的令牌使用量。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that locally records and visualizes token usage by time range, provider, and model.

capabilities: Reads provider- and runtime-reported token usage records
Stores token accounting metadata locally in a plugin-owned SQLite database
Displays aggregated usage summaries and provider/model breakdowns in a sidebar and settings page
Performs local deduplication, historical recovery, and ledger migration
